timeline.message:
Fix `to_degrees` returning infinity

This checks on `to_degrees()` return value and converts infinities to
`null`.

timeline.body:
This checks on `to_degrees()` return value and converts infinities to `null`.

Closes #102987

timeline.author: Bogdan Pintea

timeline.body: Hi @bpintea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

@not-napoleon
I've updated `pow()` to use this utility and I've been a bit more verbose than original, since failures here will always be the result of computation, ES not accepting infinites or NaN. Hope that's ok.

reply.body: Sounds good, I like the idea of standardizing these error messages.  I'll keep an eye out for other places we can do so.
